findings.evidence: Lines 87–94 define `atPoint` as the bundled fiber object, while the only constructor equations are `toSmoothModelSpace_apply` at line 199 and `product_apply` at line 232; neither rewrites equality of bundled `AlmostComplexStructure` values.
findings.fix: Add `[simp]` lemmas `toSmoothModelSpace_atPoint : J.toSmoothModelSpace.atPoint x = J` and `product_atPoint : (product V).atPoint x = AlmostComplexStructure.product V`, proved by extensionality and the existing apply lemmas.
findings.issue: `toSmoothModelSpace_apply` only characterizes vector evaluation; it cannot simplify the bundled term `J.toSmoothModelSpace.atPoint x` used by fiberwise tameness/compatibility APIs. The same gap affects `product` at line 232.

summary: The constructors lack bundled fiber-value lemmas needed by downstream predicates on `AlmostComplexStructure`.
